title: Jensen Huang: three women, four days

lines.text: Nvidia's founder just lost the company he built over thirty-three years.
The woman, the New York Times reported, was suspected by US intelligence of gathering information for China.
Wednesday. The Times reports a second relationship, with an executive who reported directly to him.
That night, the board accepts his resignation.
Thursday. Reuters reports a third. Another Nvidia employee. Still unnamed.
The stock dropped fourteen percent at the open.

lines: Follow Toppled Giants for what happens next.
